Sales.artifact_preview: ['Measure':'Measure':'FX Rate Routed'] = N: IF((['Measure':'Measure':'Use Corporate Rate'] <> 0), DB('Corporate FX', !Version, !Company, 'TargetCurrency':'TargetCurrency':'EUR', 'Measure':'Measure':'Rate'), DB('Market FX', !Version, !Company, 'TargetCurrency':'TargetCurrency':'EUR', 'Measure':'Measure':'Rate'));

artifact.feeder_rationale: Cross-cube feeder deployment is allowed because each native align branch has a bounded, metadata-proven feeder plan, so the combined branch routing can be represented as an explicit union of safe feeder statements across the required source cubes. Same-cube measures that also genuinely contribute to the formula's value (value-composing drivers, zero-gating multipliers, or branch selectors) are fed directly into the target as well, alongside the cross-cube origin.
artifact.rule_statement: ['Measure':'Measure':'FX Rate Routed'] = N: IF((['Measure':'Measure':'Use Corporate Rate'] <> 0), DB('Corporate FX', !Version, !Company, 'TargetCurrency':'TargetCurrency':'EUR', 'Measure':'Measure':'Rate'), DB('Market FX', !Version, !Company, 'TargetCurrency':'TargetCurrency':'EUR', 'Measure':'Measure':'Rate'));

Sales:FX Rate Routed.expression: case(((Sales.Use Corporate Rate != 0) -> Corporate FX.Rate.align(TargetCurrency='EUR')), default=Market FX.Rate.align(TargetCurrency='EUR'))
Sales:FX Rate Routed.rationale: Compiles within the Phase 2 MVP subset: same-cube arithmetic, comparisons, where, case, and constrained metadata-resolved cross-cube align lookups.
